title: Add AI chat analysis with parliamentary language remedies and problems solved widget

requirements.summary: Add widget to dashboard displaying total number of problems solved
acceptanceCriteria: Widget displays a numeric count of total problems solved
Count updates when problems are resolved through AI remedies or manual resolution
Widget is visible on the dashboard page

file_operations.description: Update the existing ProblemsSolvedWidget component to display a count of total problems solved (combining educational doubts resolved and family conflicts resolved). Wire it to use both getFightsSolved and any educational problem resolution count from the backend. Ensure the count updates dynamically when problems are marked as resolved.

Add a query hook useGetTotalProblemsSolved that fetches the combined count of fights solved (via getFightsSolved) and educational problems resolved. This hook should aggregate both data sources to provide a single total count for the widget.

Ensure the ProblemsSolvedWidget is properly displayed on the dashboard for both parent and child role views. Verify it's positioned appropriately in the widget grid alongside other dashboard components.

requirements.summary: Implement AI-powered chat analysis that detects problems and generates remedy suggestions
acceptanceCriteria: AI analyzes chat messages to identify problems or conflicts
System generates specific remedy suggestions for detected problems
Remedies are displayed to users in the chat interface

file_operations.description: Extend the existing AIConflictAnalysis component to integrate with the chat message history. Instead of mock data, fetch actual messages using the message history query and analyze them for conflicts. Display detected problems with AI-generated remedy suggestions in parliamentary language. Add functionality to mark remedies as applied, which should update the problems solved count. Verify the component's usage instructions from the authorization component before implementing.

Integrate the enhanced AIConflictAnalysis component into the chat page UI. Position it alongside the chat message display so users can see detected problems and remedies while conversing. Ensure the component appears only when AI remedy is enabled (controlled by the toggle in REQ-4).

Add mutation hooks for marking AI remedies as applied (useApplyRemedy) and for incrementing the problems solved counter when a remedy successfully resolves a conflict. Wire these mutations to trigger query invalidation for the total problems solved count.

requirements.summary: Add toggle control to enable or disable AI remedy feature with persistent preference
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle control is accessible in the chat interface or settings
When disabled, AI remedies are not generated or displayed
Toggle state is stored in user profile or local storage

file_operations.description: Add a toggle switch control to the chat page header that allows users to enable or disable the AI remedy feature. Wire the toggle to the user profile's aiRemedyEnabled field using the backend's getAIRemedyEnabled and setAIRemedyEnabled methods. When disabled, hide the AIConflictAnalysis component. Use shadcn/ui Switch component for consistent styling.

Add query and mutation hooks for the AI remedy toggle: useGetAIRemedyEnabled to fetch the current state from the backend and useSetAIRemedyEnabled to update the preference. Ensure the preference persists in the user profile and invalidate relevant queries on update.

Add a settings section with a toggle control for the AI remedy feature, mirroring the functionality available in the chat page. This provides an alternative access point for users who prefer to manage the setting from the settings page. Display the current state using the useGetAIRemedyEnabled query.

Update the component to respect the AI remedy enabled state. When the toggle is off, display a message indicating that AI remedies are disabled instead of showing conflict analysis. Fetch the toggle state using the useGetAIRemedyEnabled query hook.
